title: Workflow
lockedNoImage: {description} (open a frame in the viewer first)

import.label: Import
import.description: Load the captures to process, from your telescope or camera

calibrate.label: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Remove sensor defects with calibration frames: darks, flats and bias

align.label: Stack
align.description: Align and combine the frames to reduce noise

process.label: Process
process.description: Clean up and improve the data: sky background, color, noise, detail, stars

correct.label: Correct
correct.description: Stretch the histogram and adjust tones and color

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Apply photo filters, reduce noise and enhance detail

objects.label: Objects
objects.description: Find out which celestial objects are in the frame

export.label: Export
export.description: Save the finished image in the format you prefer
